name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Content Strategist & Storyteller | B2B SaaS Messaging
summary: Content strategist and messaging specialist with 15+ years in B2B marketing, writing the thought leadership, campaign copy, and messaging frameworks that turn what a business does into a story customers actually care about. As founder of Solenzo, I built the narrative and positioning for my own product from scratch, and I bring that same instinct for finding the human angle to every piece of content I write. Comfortable talking directly to customers and translating what I hear into sharper messaging.
